driver_archetypes.rationale: Compliant car drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with low acceleration/deceleration and high time headway; targets M1/car discharge headway by maintaining a conservative gap.
Passive car drivers drawn from the 'car' distribution; p=0 for all queue_space_seeking params means they behave like car_saval but are eligible for space-seeking if tuned.
Compliant motorcycle drivers (Saval et al. 2023) with aggressive tau (0.8s) and low minGap (1.9m) to reduce discharge headway and match M1/moto (observed 0.2957s).
Passive motorcycle drivers drawn from the 'moto' distribution; eligible for space-seeking and red-running rules.
Illegal left-turning motorcycles (custom1 base) drawn from 'moto_violator' distribution; jmTimegapMinor=1.0 allows them to clear the box after opposing green ends.

traci_rules.rationale: Maintains 50% red-light running probability for motorcycles at the stop line to match M3/share/moto (observed 0.098) and M4/overshoot_share (observed 0.62).
Sets early-start probability p=0.1302 to match M2/early/moto observed share (0.1302), causing motorcycles to creep over the stop line in the last 5s of red.
Activates sidewalk riding (p_sidewalk=0.75) and wrong-lane usage (p_wrong_lane=0.25) to match M10a (0.56 veh/cycle) and M8/moto (wrong-lane share 0.249), reducing queue length impacts.
High bypass probability (0.8) allows motorcycles to pass standing U-turners, reducing delay and matching field observations of aggressive maneuvering.
Low bypass probability (0.1) for cars reflects their reluctance to change lanes past U-turners, maintaining realistic car behavior.
